bills.explanation: Gym membership. US gyms usually need written cancellation notice, so cancel before you fly home or it keeps charging.
Free trial. It becomes a paid 15.99 charge on the 20th unless you cancel first.
Minimum-ish payment on your student card. Paying only this much still costs you interest; paying the full statement balance costs nothing.
Your rent. It leaves your checking account on the 1st of each month. Your lease ends when you fly home, so this is the last month you pay it.
Prepaid phone plan. Charged on the 5th. In the US the plan is usually billed a month in advance.
Health insurance required by your university. It is not optional and does not stop if you skip a payment; the charge just keeps accruing.
